content:
maria_sales: Heads-up: Trident wants a next-week POC that behaves like their /v1/generate (token math must match). They listed SSO, EU residency, and dedicated latency as must-haves. Kickoff Wed 9am PT.

alex_se: can someone drop their example request/response JSON? i want to map fields before the call.

maria_sales: uploaded to drive: https://redwood.atl/drive/trident-examples/generate.json

kevin_eng: quick mapping idea: Trident.prompt -> input, max_tokens -> token_limit, stop -> stop_sequences. note: Trident temp range 0..1; our runtime allows 0..2. we should clamp and add X-Compat-Adjust header for debugging.

nina_security: they require SAML SSO and EU-only data residency. Private (VPC) does EU, hosted can be region-restricted but audit artifacts slower. also asked for KMS integration and SOC2 evidence.

josh_sre: capacity ask: baseline 1k rps, 95ms tail SLO. recommend Dedicated reservation for the POC week or a guaranteed burst with pre-warmed instances. lead time ~3 business days to fully onboard VPC.

alex_se: response parity gotchas we saw: stop token handling and list formatting differences. plan to post-process: normalize whitespace, truncate at first stop token, and compare token billing with a harness.

kevin_eng: will add a small token-compare harness and a shim header X-Compat-Mode: trident-v1 to toggle transforms server-side. keeps changes reversible.

maria_sales: action items:
- alex_se: field mapping + example shim config (tomorrow 8am PT)
- kevin_eng: pricing delta hosted vs dedicated + rough GPU calc (EOD)
- nina_security: questionnaire answers + KMS notes (48h)
- josh_sre: confirm onboarding timeline and IP allowlist (tomorrow 9am PT)

buildbot: deploy: compat-shim branch -> staging passed smoke tests :white_check_mark:.

maria_sales: great. i'll prepare presales slide for the kickoff and send invite.

alex_se: sample shim curl for tests:
```bash
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/compat/trident/generate \n -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n -H "X-Compat-Mode: trident-v1" \n -d '{"prompt":"hi\n- item","max_tokens":40,"temperature":0.7}'
```

maria_sales: anything else?

nina_security: added export control question to the questionnaire (customer is fintech).
